title: Detect missing domain wake guidance in provider setup and CLI help composition
outcome: Behavioral surface coverage fails when the new domain/native wake guidance is omitted from setup or CLI help, without pinning its prose.
acceptance: Using existing provider/CLI output fixtures, omitting the wake guidance from either renderer composition or CLI help is detected independently of calling the same renderer as the expected output.

Wording-only changes to the shared guidance require no test update; do not read repository Markdown/instruction files, pin phrases, or add source-text assertions. Preserve existing root eligibility and first-prompt behavior.
